Explore Sargodha, Pakistan with us as we discover its busy markets , historic landmarks , religious heritage , and everyday city life.
In this video, we visit Company Bagh , Jinnah Hall, Liaquat Market , Sargodha Main Market**, and a beautiful local mosque .
We also explore an old Sanatan Dharam Temple and a historic Gurdwara , offering a glimpse into Sargodha’s pre-Partition Hindu & Sikh heritage .
We also see MC Girls Model High School, Government Ambala Muslim High School, and University of Sargodha from outside.
